newsitem.title: UK: Buyers stand aside on UK meals and feeds market.
newsitem.headline: Buyers stand aside on UK meals and feeds market.

text.p: Buyers were showing little sign of moving on the UK meals and feeds market on Wednesday as prices jumped following the firmer close in Chicago overnight.
Chicago futures rose overnight and at the opening on Wednesday afternoon on talk of China business.
Earlier traders in Shanghai said China had been buying significant quantities of U.S. soybeans and soymeal since early July as world prices slumped.
In the UK high protein soymeal sellers pushed prices up by one to three stg a tonne ex-mill while store prices were up to two stg higher.
Rapemeal ex-mill Liverpool and Hull was one stg down while the remainder of the market was unchanged.
